title: Processed peptide-level HDX-MS uptake (requested from the HDX authors), one row per measurement
description: Schema for ONE ROW of the processed HDX table (CSV with these column names, or JSON lines). Table-level rules are enforced by validate_inputs.py: unique keys, at least two replicates per peptide/state/time, the same peptide set and times in every compared state, and a matching metadata document. Values must come from the providers; nothing is inferred from figures.

ligands.description: 'none' for apo, otherwise the ligand name(s) separated by '+'

uptake_sd_Da.description: only if the provider supplies per-row spreads instead of replicate rows
